description: SX-25A: two scripted onboard emergency drills for fictional crew. Each trigger opens one local case with an owner and timestamp. Escalation never waits for vital readings or the Ground relay, so the case opens during a communication blackout.

drills.title: Chest pain drill
drills.symptom_report: Fictional drill script: SIM-01 reports chest pain.

procedure.label: Simulated training only · follow the approved onboard medical procedure.

questions.label: Is the chest pain still present?

check: Activate the simulated onboard medical alert.
Confirm the scene is safe and check responsiveness and normal breathing promptly.
responsive: Alert onboard medical and keep the crew member at rest.
Record what happened and monitor breathing and responsiveness.
breathing_concern: Observe breathing and responsiveness. Bring the AED and follow the onboard response plan.
unresponsive_breathing: Alert onboard medical and request the first-aid kit.
If safe and appropriate under the onboard plan, protect the airway with the recovery position.
unresponsive_not_breathing: Alert onboard medical and have a crew member bring the AED.
For an unresponsive adult who is not breathing normally or is only gasping, begin CPR and use an AED as soon as available, following training and the onboard plan.
chest_pain_ongoing: Alert onboard medical and bring the AED.
Have the crew member stop work and rest comfortably.
Stay with them and monitor breathing and responsiveness.
chest_pain_resolved: Alert onboard medical even if pain has eased.
Keep the crew member resting and document changes in symptoms.
Watch for changes in breathing or responsiveness.
